description.summary: The spell causes one creature per two levels (maximum of 5) within 30 feet of each other to receive the Sleep status effect.
description.value: The spell causes one creature per two levels (maximum of 5) within 30 feet of each other to receive the Sleep status effect. The victims fall into a magical slumber, can only be woken with a standard action . The targets of this spell must have a combined HD of 10 or less to be affected by this spell. Sleep: This status effect causes the creature to fall into a magical slumber. They are considered unconscious and thereby helpless. Slapping or wounding awakens an affected creature, but normal noise does not. Awakening a creature is a standard action (an application of the aid another action).
